items.definition:
a person who plays football
The young footballer dreamed of playing professionally.

cosmetic for coloring the lips
She applied a bright red lipstick before leaving.

a pungent yellow or brown paste made from mustard seeds, used as a condiment
Would you like some mustard with your hot dog?

a small bushy-tailed rodent
A squirrel ran up the tree.

a Mexican dish
We had tacos for dinner last night.

decorative paper for walls
We decided to put up new wallpaper in the living room.

a person who plays the drums
The band's new drummer is very talented.

a polite word or sign of welcome or recognition
She gave a warm greeting to all the guests.

a piece of fabric worn around the neck, head, or shoulders for warmth, fashion, or religious reasons
She wore a warm scarf to protect her neck from the cold.

a paved path for pedestrians at the side of a road
Please walk on the sidewalk to stay safe from traffic.

a Japanese dish consisting of small balls or rolls of vinegar-flavored cold rice
We went to a Japanese restaurant and ordered some sushi.

a device that measures and indicates time, especially one that can be set to ring an alarm at a particular time
She set the kitchen timer for 20 minutes to bake the cookies.

a person who travels or is traveling
The experienced traveller knew how to pack light for long trips.

a device for charging a battery
I forgot my phone charger at home.

A fabric case filled with soft material, used for sleeping on.
I need a new mattress for my bed.

An object or collection of objects wrapped in paper in order to be carried or sent by mail.
The postman delivered a large parcel this morning.

a slow-moving mollusc with a shell
A snail left a silvery trail across the path.

barbecue
We're having a BBQ in the garden this weekend.

a round part of a plant or an electric light
The light bulb in the lamp needs to be replaced.

stiff paper material
Please put the cardboard boxes in the recycling bin.

the period of time when there is light from the sun
It's much warmer during the daytime.

an appliance for freezing food
Put the ice cream back in the freezer.

plural of penny (British currency)
This item costs fifty pence.

a unit of liquid or dry capacity, equal to one half of a quart
I'll have a pint of milk, please.

feces; excrement
The dog left a poop on the sidewalk.

Short Message Service; a text message
I sent her an SMS to confirm the meeting.

A sweet, dark fruit.
We picked wild blackberries in the forest.

A short private road leading from a public road to a house or garage.
He parked his car in the driveway.

A person who catches fish for a living or as a hobby.
The old fisherman cast his net into the sea.

a large bear-like mammal native to China
The panda is a symbol of wildlife conservation.

fish and shellfish from the sea used for food
We had fresh seafood for dinner.

a desert animal
Camels can survive for a long time without water.

place to pay in a store
Please proceed to the checkout to pay for your items.

a person in the same class
My classmate helped me with my homework.

powder made from cacao beans, used to make chocolate
I like to drink hot cocoa on a cold day.

the feeling of needing to drink
He quenched his thirst with a glass of water.

a large edible marine fish
I made a tuna sandwich for lunch.

a space or room directly under the roof of a house
We store old furniture in the attic.

a person who extinguishes fires
The firefighter quickly put out the blaze.

a person who plays the guitar
The guitarist played an amazing solo.

a reptile with a long body and tail, typically four legs, and a movable eyelid
A small lizard scurried across the rock.

sister (informal)
My sis and I are going to the movies.

a meal or party at which food is cooked outdoors on a grill
We're having a barbecue in the garden this Saturday.

a domesticated hoofed mammal of the horse family
The farmer used a donkey to carry the heavy load.

a piece of jewelry worn on the lobe or edge of the ear
She lost one of her favorite earrings.

a large ape
We saw a large gorilla at the zoo.

a large rodent known for building dams
The beaver built a dam across the river.

a person who makes a phone call
The caller hung up before I could answer.

grandmother
My granny always bakes the best cookies.

the light of the moon
The garden was bathed in soft moonlight.

a small flying insect that bites
A mosquito bit me on the arm, and now it's itchy.

a roadside hotel designed for motorists
We stayed at a small motel on our road trip.

a paved surface, especially a sidewalk
We walked along the pavement to the shop.

a sweet dessert
For dessert, we had chocolate pudding.

a floor or level of a building
The building has three storeys.

a person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft
The astronaut orbited the Earth.

the daughter of one's son or daughter
My grandmother loves spending time with her granddaughter.

A person who invents something.
Thomas Edison was a famous inventor.

A large wild cat with a spotted coat.
The leopard is known for its speed.

A person who works in a library.
The librarian helped me find a book.

A person, typically a woman, employed to look after a child in its own home.
The nanny took the children to the park.

a soft, porous material used for washing
Please wipe the counter with a sponge.

a bag of cloth stuffed with soft material, used for sitting or kneeling on or for resting one's head
She plumped up the cushion on the sofa.

a large tropical fruit
I love the sweet taste of fresh pineapple.
